blocked.unblocking_condition: A later ingestion job copies the authorized source file and verifies it against the recorded commit and SHA-256.
An authorized retrieval job checks reachability, ownership, license, provenance, and content without bypassing access controls.
An authorized retrieval job confirms lawful access and records stable item-level metadata and validation evidence.
An authorized retrieval job downloads into quarantine, records a digest, scans and safely extracts the archive, and classifies its files.
The learner or institution supplies lawful access; a later job may record metadata or permitted excerpts but must not copy restricted text into learner artifacts.

retrieval_policy.current_job: Classify catalog metadata only. Do not fetch remote or restricted content.
retrieval_policy.default_for_links: A URL is evidence of a catalog pointer, not evidence of availability, integrity, license, content, or official unit status.
later_jobs_may: Retrieve public materials only when explicitly authorized and permitted by their access and license terms.
Record final URL, retrieval result, content digest, media type, size, license evidence, and provenance.
Quarantine and inspect archives before exposing extracted files.
Ask for learner- or institution-provided lawful access when a required work is restricted.
later_jobs_must_not: Bypass authentication, paywalls, geographic controls, robots restrictions, or technical access controls.
Treat a bibliographic citation or catalog description as possession of the work.
Expose secrets, sealed references, hidden grader material, or files from another learner.
Promote a normalized resource record into an official unit solely because it has a title, order, or URL.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: Material may support later unit expansion only after deterministic availability and provenance checks; official sequencing additionally requires syllabus-level evidence.
retrieval_policy.fallback: If retrieval remains unavailable, build only explicitly manager-authored, self-contained units and keep the missing dependency visible.

provenance.classification_basis: catalog snapshot and normalized resource records supplied to the preparation job
